prompt:
Turn the attached photo into a coloring-book page.

Keep: the person's pose, proportions, hairstyle, facial features and clothing exactly as photographed, so the page is recognisably them.

Change: render everything as clean black line art on pure white. Uniform medium-weight outlines, no shading, no hatching, no grey fills, no gradients. Simplify small details (fabric folds, hair strands) into closed shapes that are easy to colour with a pencil. Add a simple background of a few large closed shapes: a doorway arch behind the figure and two potted plants at the sides, drawn in the same line weight.

Composition: full body centred, generous white margin all round, portrait orientation. No text, no watermark, no signature.
